messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Signs of an allergic reaction to methylphenidate include difficulty breathing.
Signs of an allergic reaction to methylphenidate include swelling of your face, lips, tongue, or throat.
Call your doctor at once if you have:
signs of heart problems - chest pain, trouble breathing, feeling like you might pass out;
signs of psychosis - hallucinations (seeing or hearing things that are not real), new behavior problems, aggression, hostility, paranoia;
signs of circulation problems - numbness, pain, cold feeling, unexplained wounds, or skin color changes (pale, red, or blue appearance) in your fingers or toes; or
penis erection that is painful or lasts 4 hours or longer.
signs of skin problems from the patch - swelling or blisters at the application site, or loss of skin color;
Seek medical attention right away if you have symptoms of serotonin syndrome.

The relation 'includes symptom' in the triplet is defined as 'The medical condition or adverse effect specified by the subject entity may present with the symptom or sign specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has symptom': The medical condition specified by the subject may present with the symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
C. 'can lead to': The subject condition or event may result in the medical complication or outcome specified by the object entity.
D. 'occurs in': The subject medical condition is observed or experienced by the group of individuals specified by the object entity.
E. 'has reporting information': The subject drug has information available for reporting side effects or adverse events to the entity specified by the object.
F. None of the above.
